name: pboc_get_economic_indicator
description:
One Chinese economic indicator from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; World Bank, OECD and BIS series): GDP, GDP growth, unemployment, industrial production, retail sales, exports, imports, FDI or the residential property price index.
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): indicator (gdp, gdp_growth, unemployment, industrial_production, retail_sales, exports, imports, fdi, house_price_index; default gdp_growth); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; the last N observations; with no dates it looks back N x 45 days); omit all three for the full history.
pboc_list_series shows the FRED id behind each. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"indicator": "industrial_production", "start_date": "2019-01-01"}
